item.title: Viewpoints: Rural Hospital Closures Are a North Carolina Problem
item.description: A hospital closure in an area with a small population may not seem important but the ripple effect is vast and may end up impacting you. The root cause of most rural hospital closures is straightforward: rural hospitals cannot negotiate as effectively as larger urban systems with private insurers.
